integrity: General theorem proved using the labelled extension SET decomposition and analytic independence. The checker is corroborative, not an independent audit or infinite verification.
scientific_limitations: Finite nonzero distance alphabet, nonempty individually named finite base; the proof is unrestricted in finite arity but the executable enumeration is finite. Known Bell and nested-partition special cases are excluded from novelty claims. Possible implicit coverage in generalized marked-partition literature remains a risk.
title: Finite-base ultrametric tuple spectra recover ball counts, but not branch sizes
